neutral_swim_path_059.scope: Ordinary living Neutral adult with locked Swim FIRST evolution. Six balanced/Run/Power/Swim/Run+Swim/Power+Swim specialization targets. No positive Fly specialization.
neutral_swim_path_059.reference: Independently operated Chao Island viewer first-Swim checkbox: all six mature front, both sides and back, above and below, shared fresh form and intermediate age comparisons. Original official Swim cuboids/fins supply block construction vocabulary only.
neutral_swim_path_059.approximation: Unchanged square head with a broad three-box stepped cap/rear hood and two closed cuboids per temple fin. The fresh posterior cap is already substantial. Run raises its fins and rear cap, Power has short thick fins and a blunt hood, Swim has a long dropped hood and hanging flippers; mixed endpoints are intermediate forms. Curved hems, tapered leaves and zigzag bands are simplified into closed angled boxes and flat per-face color regions.
neutral_swim_path_059.wing_policy: Thin closed original UV wings, visible front mirrored onto back, alpha-consistent closing edges, exact local root-edge midpoint [0,.25,0], original parent yaw/pivots/animations.
neutral_swim_path_059.provisional_rates: 960 current level-bar progress per opposing axis; independent adult age. No original-game timing claim.
